ask: The company's license or registration number, and its class
Any job-size limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.holder: The business; plus a qualifying person where the state's form names one. A crew that lays buried drain pipe holds that license where the state asks.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
blocks: No gutter work goes live until the company's license checks out, where one is required
A job over the license's size limit is never offered or quoted: the owner is told why
pf.license.declared_emergency: In a declared emergency, the owner says which licenses in that area have lapsed, and a gutter installer new to the state is held until the owner says yes, where the state's rules say so
pf.license.renewals: License, insurance and bond dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.lead_safe: Work that disturbs painted fascia or trim on older homes only by a firm and a person certified for lead-safe work, where the rules require it
pf.license.showroom: The studio: a registration, and a salesperson's registration for each consultant who sells gutter work, only where the state's form asks
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.pattern: Inspection, then project: new gutters are booked only after a written estimate and a signed contract

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or consultant per booking; one crew per job, up to 200 feet in a day; the studio's layout table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Inspections and estimates: estimators. Installs: crew leads with their crews. Buried drain lines: licensed installers. Studio: consultants.
pf.services.nobody_home: Gutter work outside: nobody needs to be home; a start photo and day-end photos. An adult is needed only if the inspection needs a look inside at a wet wall or the basement.
pf.services.online: No video consult: gutter picks use the sample runs at the studio

before_times: What's wrong: gutters that overflow, sag or leak, a storm, or an old house?
What are the gutters made of now, if you know: aluminum, steel, vinyl or copper?
About how many feet of gutter, or how big is the house?
How many stories is the house?
Is water getting into the house or the basement now?
after_time: The year the home was built (painted fascia on older homes may need lead-safe work, where the rules require it)
OK to put a ladder against the house and take photos?
Will an adult be home if the inspection needs a look inside?
Gate, pets and parking (the crew needs room for a truck and a ladder)
Do you own the home or rent? (the owner signs any contract)
Is the home in an owners' association or a historic district? (some need approval before a new color or material)
secure_page_only: The association's or district's approval letter, if the home needs one
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the home, or someone with the owner's written OK. Everyone on the home's title signs a gutter contract. A renter may book an inspection or a cleaning only with the owner's OK.
showroom: Which part of the house: the gutters, the downspouts or the guards
Photos of the house, and an old section if there is one (optional)

stop.words: a tree or limb on the house or across the gutters, power lines down on or near the house
stop.says: Leave the house and stay far from the lines. Then call 911 and the power company.
stop.booking: no booking until the house is safe

stop.words: a wall or ceiling sagging or bulging under the water, gutters pulling the roof edge down
stop.says: Get everyone out of the rooms by that wall or ceiling, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

stop.words: a gas smell, sparking or smoking wires
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.

steps_then_go_on.words: water overflowing into the house, the basement or a wall, a wet or stained ceiling or wall
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep everyone away from the water and any outlet it reaches. Don't go into a flooded basement. Turn that area off at the breaker only if it's safe to reach. Don't climb a ladder to look.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent; the soonest inspection time is offered first

steps_then_go_on.words: a gutter hanging loose or falling
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep people and pets away from it. Don't climb a ladder to fix it.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent; the soonest inspection time is offered first

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about whether a roof edge or a wall is safe, or about the structure, go to the business's own line
pf.safety.never: Customers are told never to climb a ladder to clean, look at or fix gutters

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The inspection at the home: each run measured, the downspouts and where they drain, the fascia checked for rot, photos by side
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one
Custom-cut gutter runs and parts are ordered only after the window
For a buried drain line: the utility locate (buried lines marked) before any digging, and any permit the state's rules require, pulled by the license holder
A dry forecast for the work day
prep: Before the work: move cars, planters and chairs 5 feet from the walls, trim back bushes, and keep pets inside
An adult home only if the inspection needs a look inside
showroom_prep: Bring an old section of gutter or a paint chip, if there is one
pf.first_steps.sample_pickup: A 15-minute sample pickup before a full drainage plan, at least 2 days before, so the runs are seen on the house in daylight

pf.visit.check_in: Inspection: the check-in code at the door. Work day: nobody needs to be home; the crew texts a start photo. Studio: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The gutters are checked from the ground and from a ladder only when it's dry and calm. Photos of each run, feet measured, downspouts and drains traced, fascia checked for rot. The written estimate comes the same day, good for 30 days. Nothing is signed or paid at the inspection.
pf.visit.bad_weather: No ladder work in rain, ice or high wind: inspect from the ground, or move the time
pf.visit.changes: Rotted fascia at the contract's price per foot, up to the feet OK'd in the contract, with photos and a change order for the record. Past it, a signed change order before that work.
pf.visit.work_day: Plants and the AC unit covered or moved; old gutters hauled away the same day; seams sealed and every run hose-tested; a magnet sweep of the yard, driveway and flower beds for screws and cut-off pieces, with photos; day-end photos to the customer
pf.visit.outside_checks: None for gutters; a permit inspection only for a buried drain line, where the permit requires it
pf.visit.done: The hose test, then the walk-around and sweep, then DONE
pf.visit.showroom_done: DONE after the consult, with the picks saved for the inspection and estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: Each run, the downspouts, the fascia and any inside stains

pf.money.inspection: The example's $89 inspection counts toward the gutter work, and is billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is a safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On new gutters, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.balance: After the hose test and the final walk-around; never ahead of the work
pf.money.insurance: Where a storm claim pays, the money goes to the customer, never through Rosie or the business. The deductible is always the customer's: never paid, waived or rebated.
pf.money.storm_prices: In a declared emergency, prices stay at the list from before it, for as long as the state's rules say
pf.money.rosfield_fee: Rosfield's $2 can be switched off by state and by who pays, where a state's rule on pay for referrals reaches it (a switch from the state's form, for counsel to confirm)
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the crew lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.showroom: The drainage plan session's $55 counts toward the gutters if Alex signs with Lee Gutters; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home never lets the crew in
pf.messages.no_claim_ads: No text ever urges anyone to file an insurance claim

pf.staff.roles: Estimators and crew leads (Felix, Ines): inspections, estimates, and installs with their crews. Studio consultants (Mara, Kofi).
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the gutter or contractor license; installers of buried drain lines hold their own where the state asks, checked before they're named on a job
pf.staff.lead_safe: A certified renovator on any job that disturbs painted fascia or trim on an older home, where lead-safe rules apply
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another estimator may take an inspection; an install keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it
pf.staff.on_call: None: every job is booked ahead
pf.staff.power_lines: A crew never sets a metal ladder against or near an overhead service wire; a wire touching the gutter stops that run (the electric company's job)

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for new gutters where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, price, dates, deposit, cancel notice, any lien or recovery-fund notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; a longer one for contracts signed in a declared emergency, where the rules say so. Work and orders wait for it.
pf.rules.insurance_claims: The business never files, adjusts or explains the customer's claim, unless the state's rules allow it; no gifts or rebates tied to an inspection or a claim
pf.rules.permits: A buried drain line: pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's, where the rules require one. Gutters alone: none unless the state's rules say so.
pf.rules.approvals: An owners' association or historic approval comes from the owner before work starts, where the home needs one
pf.rules.drain_outlet: A downspout drain is laid out only where the water may go, as the state's and the place's rules say; never onto a neighbor's land or into the street without the OK the rules require
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before added work, past what the contract already OK'd
pf.rules.final: The hose test and the final walk-around before the balance is asked for
pf.rules.lien_release: A lien release with the final payment, where the state's rules provide one
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the times read out, the confirmation, the estimate, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.storm_prices: Prices from before a declared emergency, for as long as the state's rules say
pf.rules.warranty: 5 years on new gutters' workmanship against leaks and sagging, and 1 year on repairs (the example's); the maker's finish warranty registered in the owner's name

pf.edges.weather: No gutter work in rain, ice or high wind, and no sealant below the maker's lowest temperature (the example business's own limits: a 40% chance of rain or more, or under 40 degrees); a weather move never costs the customer
pf.edges.wet_roof_edge: Rain at inspection time: a look from the ground, or a new time
pf.edges.water_getting_in: Safety steps first, then the soonest inspection time
pf.edges.hidden_damage: Rotted fascia: at the contract's price per foot, inside the feet OK'd; past it, a signed change order first
pf.edges.power_wire: An electric service wire touching or close to a gutter run: the crew stops that run, the customer gets a written note, and the electric company comes first
pf.edges.old_paint: Old paint on fascia that may hold lead: lead-safe work first, where the rules require it
pf.edges.buried_lines: Digging for a drain line starts only after the utility locate, and a marked line in the way moves the plan with no fee
pf.edges.color_match: An old gutter color or profile that is no longer made: the consultant checks a sample, and the customer picks a close match or a full replacement; an exact match is never promised
pf.edges.ice_and_snow: Gutters packed with ice or snow are not cleaned or hung: the visit moves with no fee, and the customer is told
pf.edges.late_delivery: Special-order runs and colors are ordered only after the cancel window; a late delivery moves the work day with no fee, and the customer is told
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.nobody_home: Work days: start and day-end photos
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
New profession on the REDESIGN 2 master (batch P4, Tue Oct 27 2026), built from roofer (refitted that morning, check-prof 0/0) and shaped like siding (the other P4 build). Why roofer: gutters run the same way: an inspection at the home first, then a written estimate, a contract signed by everyone on title for a new set, a cancel window, the work day, a final walk-around and the last bill. Unlike the roofer: never sent now, one work day (not several), no permit for gutters alone, and no insurance chain (a storm claim, where one pays, is the customer's and is one line in pf.money; the roofer's own insurance steps are not carried).
Flow B main path (visit|none|bill): sagging, leaking gutters at 19 Linden Ct after a windstorm. The booking is the $89 gutter inspection, credited to the work if Alex signs (billed only if no contract follows); Felix quotes the repair at the visit ($245: gutter run $165 + downspout $80); the bill comes after. Other B paths: visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, list|card|bill and list|none|bill (gutter repair, up to 20 feet re-hung and resealed, $179 from the list), photos|deposit|bill (gutter guards, $640 from photos, 25% deposit $160), list|full|none (gutter cleaning, $150 paid in full, also the yearly plan). The flow test and report ($199) is added at a visit and paid with the rest.
New gutters are their own job on the master's estimate path (B8-93 '1 Signs the contract' -> B8-62 -> B8-63 start payment -> B8-78 cancel window, switch cancelright on in B only -> B9-21 stage bills). The master's big-job example is Harper J.'s $2,400 gutters and downspouts in three stages ($800 / $800 / $800). Alex's own estimate in the own steps is a whole-house set: 160 feet of 5-inch seamless aluminum at $11 a foot ($1,760), 6 downspouts at $85 ($510), $330 for taking down and hauling the old gutters: $2,600 in one day.
Own steps (B): B8-x07 and B8-x08 Sam orders the custom-cut runs after the cancel window (Wed Oct 28, due before Mon Nov 2) and calls for the utility locate if anything will be dug; a late color or locate moves the work day with no fee (new days Mon Nov 9 or Tue Nov 10); B8-x11 to B8-x14 the work day (start photo, rotted fascia inside the 20 feet OK'd at $14 a foot, past 20 Alex's signed change order first, hung and hose-tested with the screw sweep). Own step in A: A8-x01 offers the inspection at home (it runs in flow B).
The stop words: a tree or limb on the house, power lines down, a wall or ceiling sagging under water, gas smell or sparks. Water coming into the house or basement and a gutter hanging loose get the safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent. B8-30's hazard is an electric service wire touching a gutter run (stop that run, written note, the electric company first). A crew never sets a metal ladder near an overhead wire. Nobody climbs a ladder to look or fix.
Licenses: a contractor, home improvement or gutter license at the company, where the state's form requires one; a job-size limit blocks a quote; drain-pipe installers and studio sellers hold their own where the state asks; lead-safe rules for painted fascia on older homes as a switch. No state, city or law is named; no license numbers except the EX- format. Not booked: a minor; a renter without the owner's OK for a contract; a job over the license limit; a home needing an association or historic approval that is not in.
Fee and money rules: the $89 inspection is the late-cancel and no-show fee (visit|card|bill) and is owed after a no to the price; deposits only after signing; nothing taken before the contract is signed by everyone; the balance after the hose test and walk-around; no tip line (S1-21's tip row is paired out); added work is paid with the rest at the visit (D91). The $89 fee stays for the $179 repair and $150 cleaning too (97 master steps hard-code $89); the owner may set a smaller fee.
Flow A is the studio (Lee Gutter Studio, Sam's second company, consultants Mara and Kofi): style consult $35 (card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee; or at home for $75), downspout and color pick $40, guard match $25, sample kit $20; drainage plan session $55 paid in full; full drainage plan $140 with a $40 deposit; photo gutter plan $90 from photos (Sam OKs); copper gutter match priced at the studio after the $25 consult.
